description: Curated assets added after the research draft (WP3 gap fill, 2026-11-18). uuid/name/geometry copied from the local catalog extract (Extract-AssetCatalog.ps1 output); consumed by import-palette-draft.ts. Facing of these props is UNVERIFIED. lintel.wall (Castle Ruins Crenellation - Small) was removed after the in-game check on 2026-11-18: it rendered as battlements above the doors; no Dungeon Cellar lintel/doorway piece exists, so no lintel role is shipped. Entries with batch "set-dressing" (2026-11-19) widen the cave and generic kits: cave floors, thin rock walls, ledge/cliff faces, lava, bridges and railings, stalagmites/stalactites, crystals, roots, great trees, ritual props and more light sources; geometry copied from the local catalog index (packages/core/test/unit/palette-catalog.test.ts checks every id against it when present). Stalactites are raised so their top is 2.5 above the floor (tip-down orientation UNVERIFIED in game); wall roots and vines mount on their S side (UNVERIFIED). Entries with batch "structures" (2026-11-20) are the building kit used by Level.structures: the Abandoned Village slate roof (rot 0 = eave north, verified in game on the forest-shack test), weathered timber facade, stone footing course, attic deck, chimney blocks and pot, door lantern (mounts on its S side; read well in game), porch posts and the palisade gate.
